title: Ceylon Blue Sapphires: The Story Behind the Stone
excerpt: From the riverbeds of Ratnapura to the world's finest jewellery houses — discover what makes Ceylon blue sapphires the most sought-after gems on the planet.
content:
Ceylon blue sapphires have been treasured for over two thousand years. Their distinctive cornflower-blue hue, exceptional clarity and natural origin set them apart from sapphires sourced anywhere else in the world.

In this article we explore the geological story, the mining heritage, and what to look for when buying one.

title: Why These Gorgeous Gemstones From Sri Lanka Captivate Collectors
excerpt: Sri Lanka — known as Ratna-Dweepa or 'Gem Island' — has produced extraordinary gemstones for centuries. Here's why connoisseurs keep coming back.
content:
Few destinations rival Sri Lanka for the sheer variety of precious and semi-precious gems found in such a small geographical area.

We walk you through the major mining regions, the most prized stones, and what a gem tour with us looks like in practice.

title: From Sketch to Heirloom: Our Custom Jewellery Design Process
excerpt: A behind-the-scenes look at how we turn an idea into a finished piece of jewellery — and why the gemstone always leads the design.
content: Every custom commission begins with the stone. From the first consultation through CAD design, wax model, casting and final polish, we walk you through every stage of bringing a one-of-a-kind piece to life.
